rows.grounds: abbreviated expression indicating milk and similar substances; taken as source materials in context
ellipsis marking omission or continuation of a list of substances
substances or materials used for filling
injunctive or prescriptive action of filling
refers to the body or form previously indicated

items.question: With what kinds of filling substances must that body be continually filled?
premises: Milk and similar substances are indicated as materials.
Various filling substances are to be employed.
The act prescribed is the filling of that body.
items.inference: Therefore, that body should always be filled using milk and other such various filling substances.
uncertainties: The exact items omitted by the ellipsis token are unspecified.
The precise referent of tattanuṃ depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: One should always fill that body with milk and other such various filling substances.
